lines.line: Unruly world, the wind blows cold, but you still walk on
Feet bruised up but the road not gone
You carry weight, a heavy load, but strength builds up on this rough old road
Stand up strong, even when you fall
Rise again, you can have it all
Stay true to your heart, let it lead the way
Stand up strong, make it true today
